bio.text: Bryan Brinyark, a Republican, has represented District 16 in the Alabama House of Representatives since taking office on January 10, 2024, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Brinyark was born and raised in Tuscaloosa County, graduated from Central High School in 1986, and earned a bachelor's degree in 1990 and a J.D. in 1993, both from the University of Alabama.
He works as a partner attorney with Brinyark & Frederick and has served as municipal judge for Centreville since 2005; he previously held the same role for Brent and Woodstock.
